key_insight: The paper establishes a validated, reproducible LBM dataset pipeline for turbulent 3D obstructed channel flows to benchmark neural surrogates against physical flow metrics.
engineering_relevance: It provides a standardized foundation for comparing surrogate models such as Fourier Neural Operators and U-Nets on realistic CFD tasks, helping accelerate reduced-order design and analysis workflows.
method: Generate 3D channel-flow geometries and simulate turbulent cases at Re=1,000–10,000 using a cumulant LBM solver.
Validate the solver against experimental Strouhal number, drag, and turbulent fluctuation benchmarks.
Perform grid convergence studies at up to 1024x512x512 resolution to support dataset reliability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports rigorous validation against experimental measurements plus comprehensive grid-convergence testing, with planned evaluations using physics-informed metrics for forecasting, super-resolution, and error correction.
watch_item: Model comparisons may be sensitive to the chosen benchmark setup and metric definitions, so reproducibility and fair task specification will be critical.
paper_title: A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
